fr: Use informal 'tu/toi/ton/ta/tes' (not 'vous'). Swiss French punctuation: do NOT add a space before ':', '!', '?', ';' or inside guillemets — write ':' not ' :'. Use natural Swiss French phrasing.
de: Use informal 'du/dich/dir/dein' (not 'Sie'). Swiss German context: use '«»' quotation marks instead of '„"' if quoting is needed.
es: Use informal 'tú/ti/tu/tus' (not 'usted', not 'vos'). Favour mexican Spanish over pan-Hispanic Spanish.
pt-BR: Use informal 'tu'. Write in standard Brazilian Portuguese spelling and grammar.
